events.prune_compact: _prune_optimizer slices exp_avg/exp_avg_sq by keep mask. Discarded rows need no appearance materialization. Deferred timestamps for survivors remapped with rows. Feasible.
events.checkpoint: capture() saves theta only. Lazy rows must be materialized before checkpoint serialization (or lazy metadata serialized losslessly). Feasible with a materialize-before-save hook.
events.evaluation: Eval renders images; visible rows' deferred appearance materialized before render. Feasible.
events.optimizer_state_remap: cat_tensors_to_optimizer / _prune_optimizer already remap Adam state across topology; deferred-timestamp metadata would be remapped identically. Feasible.
